Episode endings: the three illustrations

V3 B2 (D132), 2026-10-25. Generated by tools/art/gen_endings.py from the Gemini paintings (local, D77). Proposed and installed on the branch as provisional: nothing is released until the CEO says yes. Engine pass pending (D26).

1. When they show: the proposed order

Stats
kills, items, secrets, time over the operations map (ADR 013, B1)
→
Awards
the five medals revealed one by one (ADR 013, B3); a key shows all, the next leaves
→
Ending text
the cluster's SD_ENDnn_TEXT over SDFLR1, as today
→
Illustration
SDEND1/2/3 full screen, 4:3, no text over it; waits for a key
→
Title screen
TITLEPIC and the title music, as today

At the end of MAP03, MAP06 and MAP09 the player sees the stats, then the awards, then the episode's ending text, then the illustration full screen, and a key goes to the title. This is Doom's own order (Doom 1's episode 1: the text, then a picture), so it needs no new code: the map's next names our end sequence instead of the plain endtitle, and that sequence is the picture, then the title. The text tells what happened; the picture closes on it with nothing printed over the art.

OptionWhat it meansVerdict
A. text, then picture (recommended)the engine's built-in order; the ending texts stay in their clusters, unchanged in English, Russian and Catalaninstalled
B. picture, then textthe three ending texts move out of the clusters into our sequence; they would be drawn by a different path (colour, font, layout to be checked again) possible, if the CEO prefers it
C. picture behind the text8-10 lines over a busy painting would not read without dimming it to half, which loses the artnot recommended
